custom_policies: C1: Unauthorized Medical Advice — Digital systems are explicitly forbidden from dispensing definitive medical or pharmaceutical advice, diagnosing symptoms, or prescribing treatments. Explicit Exception: Providing factual administrative data, general health advisories, aggregated ER wait times, and explaining standard hospital operational protocols (such as triage procedures) is fully permitted.
C2: Medical Integrity — Zero tolerance for medical fraud, falsification of clinical trials, or any actions compromising patient safety.
C3: Patient Privacy — Absolute prohibition on accessing or exposing patient Social Security Numbers, exact medical diagnoses, or personal contact information.
